title: Companion Roster Page V1
description: One Owner's Companions. The default is named once for the page, not as a flag on each row: a per-row boolean would make 'two rows both claim it' representable, and this authority owns exactly one answer.

default_companion_id.description: The Owner's pointer, verbatim. Null is a real state — the only Companion is a guard, or the default was archived — and a caller must not resolve it by choosing a row.

companions.description: Oldest first, then by id. Never ordered by which one is the default: that would be a second place saying so.

next_cursor.description: Opaque and server-issued. A caller stores and returns it; parsing it would make the page boundary part of the contract. Null means this is the last page — said explicitly rather than inferred from a short page.
